child.label: Transport & lodging
child.description: Questions about how travelers get around and where they stay, such as airlines, flights, airports, trains, cruises, hotels and home rentals.
child.not_for: Entry rules, visas and passports go to Visas & passports; destinations themselves go to Tourism.
examples: Is a window seat better than an aisle seat on a long-haul flight?
Is renting through Airbnb better than staying in a hotel?
